title: ChatRequest
$comment: Role: the canonical chat generation request (docs/architecture.md §3.1; ocai/chat/types/request.py) in omit-absent wire form — the shape `chat.request` payload the conversion graph encodes from the canonical node to a provider node. There is deliberately NO `model` member: the model name is provider routing data bound to the model object at construction (§3.4) and injected into the wire payload from the bound resource at send time — never part of the portable conversation. Knobs obey the three-lane law (§3.4): first-class typed fields live in `config` here; provider-unique data rides censused `extensions`; destination passthrough rides `provider_options` namespaced by destination interface (both on the shared envelope). Single-response forever: there is no `n`.
description: A provider-neutral chat request: the conversation, the tools the model may call, the whether/which tool policy, and the typed generation config.

messages.description: The conversation so far, in order.

tools.description: The tools the model may call; omitted when none.

tool_choice.description: The whether/which tool policy; omitted when unconstrained.

config.description: The typed generation configuration; omitted when every knob is the provider default.

jsonSchemaDocument.$comment: A JSON Schema (Draft 2020-12) document carried as data, not applied by this spec: an object-form schema or a boolean schema (true = anything, false = nothing). Unknown keywords are preserved losslessly (ocai/core/jsonschema.py).

tool.$comment: ocai/chat/types/tools.py Tool — a model-invocable tool as pure, serializable data; no callable is retained.

name.description: The tool's name, as exposed to the model.

parameters.description: JSON Schema describing the tool's input parameters.

output.description: JSON Schema describing the tool's output, when known.

toolChoice.$comment: ocai/chat/types/tools.py ToolChoice — codecs map the open mode onto each dialect's idiom (OpenAI tool_choice, Anthropic tool_choice, Gemini functionCallingConfig).

mode.description: The open choice code. Known canonical values: auto (model decides), none (no tool may be called), required (at least one call), named (must call the tool in `name`). Unknown values are legal and preserved verbatim.

name.description: The tool the model must call when mode is named.

chatConfig.$comment: ocai/chat/types/config.py ChatConfig — every field is optional and omitted when unset (provider default). Honesty rule: out-of-range values pass VERBATIM with an APPROXIMATED report — never rescaled, never clamped, never silent.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature, passed verbatim — out-of-range values are APPROXIMATED-reported, never clamped.

max_output_tokens.description: The output token ceiling, reasoning included where the provider counts it that way (dialect codecs own the per-interface accounting shift).

stop_sequences.description: Sequences that end generation when emitted.

parallel_tool_calls.description: Whether the model may emit several tool calls in one turn.

top_k.description: Profile-gated top-k sampling cutoff: the feature gate consults the destination's CapabilityProfile before conversion.

logprobs.description: Profile-gated count of top logprobs to return per token; omitted disables.

modalities.description: The open output-modality codes requested. Known values: text, audio. Omitted means text.

audio.description: Audio-output settings, meaningful when "audio" is in modalities [provisional].

reasoning.description: How much the model should think and whether thoughts are surfaced.

reasoningConfig.$comment: ocai/chat/types/config.py ReasoningConfig — bridges the two native idioms (effort levels vs token budgets) as sibling optionals; the codec maps or APPROXIMATED-reports the translation.

effort.description: The open effort code. Known canonical values: low, medium, high. Unknown values are legal and preserved verbatim.

budget_tokens.description: The maximum tokens the model may spend thinking.

include_thoughts.description: Whether reasoning content should be surfaced as reasoning parts in the response.

outputFormat.$comment: ocai/chat/types/config.py OutputFormat — the structured-output contract for a generation.

mode.description: The open output-mode code. Known canonical values: text (free-form, the default), json (provider-enforced syntactically-valid JSON, no schema), json_schema (provider-enforced conformance to `schema`). Unknown values are legal.

name.description: The schema's name, where the destination requires one (OpenAI json_schema.name).

schema.description: The JSON Schema the output must conform to when mode is json_schema.

strict.description: Whether the provider must enforce the schema exactly rather than best-effort.

audioOutputConfig.$comment: ocai/chat/types/config.py AudioOutputConfig [provisional] — only one first-party interface (OpenAI audio) exercises it today.

format.description: The requested audio container/encoding as an open code (e.g. wav, mp3, pcm16).

cacheConfig.$comment: ocai/chat/types/config.py CacheConfig [provisional] — the request-scoped complement to per-part cache hints.

mode.description: The open caching-mode code. Known values: auto, explicit, off. Omitted means the provider default.

ref.description: An existing provider-side cache handle to generate against (Gemini cachedContent — the model-scoped exemplar: crossing another (provider, interface) is reported UNSUPPORTED, and changing the bound model is breakage, per the ProviderRef scoped crossing rule).
